fields.mechanism: Immersive demonstrations with force feedback lead to trajectories that are quicker to execute and reduce variation in demonstrator forces
fields.intervention: Integrate force feedback sensors into the robotic gripper and manipulation cell to provide fingertip and palm-level force information during human demonstrations of pick-and-place tasks
fields.expected_effect: The policy will learn more robust placement behaviors that are less dependent on proxy rewards and maintain high placement success rates across novel object shapes
fields.falsification_test: Compare placement success rates of policies trained with vs. without force feedback demonstrations when tested on 200 novel SKUs
fields.mechanism_source_span: Results show that force feedback significantly reduces demonstrator fingertip and palm forces, leads to a lower variation in demonstrator forces, and recorded trajectories that are quicker to execute.

fields.intervention: Implement force feedback in the teleoperation system used to collect initial demonstrations for the PPO policy, allowing human operators to feel fingertip and palm forces during object manipulation
fields.expected_effect: The collected demonstrations will capture more physically accurate manipulation behaviors that are less dependent on proxy rewards, leading to more robust placement success when facing novel object shapes
fields.falsification_test: Compare placement success rates of policies trained with vs. without force feedback demonstrations when tested on 200 novel SKUs across a quarterly rotation
